title: Add Mistral & Phi catalog entries, pin versions, and publish performance profiles
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Create new model-catalog entries for the Mistral (instruct variants) and Phi families, add deterministic version-pinning policy for these entries, and publish comprehensive performance profiles and runtime compatibility notes to the catalog and docs site. This covers metadata (families, variant tags, quantization compatibility), recommended pin formats, perf measurements (P50/P95 latency, tokens/s, memory footprints) across H100/A100 and CPU fallbacks, and the documentation PR that surface these details for customers and internal teams.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Catalog entries created under 'mistral' and 'phi' families with required metadata fields populated.
2) Version pinning examples and policy documented in the catalog guide (semantic + build tag recommendations).
3) Performance profiles published for FP16, INT8 (awq/act), and int4-ish quantizations with measured P50/P95 latency and throughput for sequences 128/512/2048.
4) Runtime compatibility tags (h100,a100,int8-friendly,cpu-fallback) added and validated by CI.
5) Docs site PR merged and a short changelog entry added to release notes.
steps:
1) Collect model artifacts and canonical model identifiers (owner, repo, artifact hash) - owner: Evan.
2) Run standardized perf harness on H100 and A100 (seq=128/512/2048) with tokens generated by workload suite - owner: Marco.
3) Record memory footprints and cache behavior; capture KV cache warm/cold curves - owner: Aisha.
4) Produce metadata JSON: family, architecture, typical sequence lengths, recommended quantization, default batch sizes, kernel hints.
5) Draft docs PR with pin examples, migration notes, and sample API calls for pinning.
6) Publish performance profile to catalog and set 'published_at' in metadata.
7) QA: smoke tests, CI validation, and ask PM for approval before merge.
notes:
Decisions & trade-offs: we will default to pin major.minor.build where available (eg. mistral-1.3.2) to allow small hotfix rollouts without surprise changes. For community models missing stable build metadata, use commit-hash pins and mark as 'community-rolling' with clear warning in the catalog. Quantization recommendation: AWQ8 for Phi-family for best cost/quality tradeoff; Mistral instruct variants show lower degradation with int8-act in our tests. Known issues: Mistral-22B has a KV cache memory spike at seq>1024 on older kernels; flagged as 'kernel-risk' until kernel upgrade lands in runtime-1.22. Kernel hints include enabling flash-attn-v2 and preferring cuBLAS Lt GEMMs for seq<=512.
Monitoring: add perf regression alerts scoped to these entries in Optimize (evals set: mistral_phi_smoke_set).

migration_notes:
Existing customers using model aliases (eg. "mistral-instruct") will continue to resolve to the current stable default. Recommend customers pin explicitly for production by using the 'pin' field in the API: model: 'mistral-instruct@v1.3.2' or commit pin 'mistral-instruct@sha-abcdef'. Added examples to docs.
Backward compatibility: runtime will accept both semantic pins and commit pins; when both exist behavior is to prefer exact commit pin if provided.
